declaration.uiText: I hereby declare that the information furnished in this application form is true, complete, and correct to the best of my knowledge and belief. I understand that any incorrect or false information will disqualify me from the selection process and may result in rejection at any stage of recruitment. I consent to the collection and use of my personal data solely for the purpose of this campus recruitment drive in accordance with applicable data protection regulations.
declaration.pdfText: I hereby declare that all information furnished above is true, correct and complete to the best of my knowledge. I understand that any false or misleading information will disqualify my candidature. I consent to processing of my personal data for campus recruitment purposes as per {companyName} data policy.

instructions: This form is for the exclusive use of {companyName} Campus Drive.
Bring original documents for verification on the day of interview.
Report to the venue at least 30 minutes before the scheduled time.
Carry a printed copy of this application along with a valid photo ID.
Mobile phones must be switched off during the selection process.
False or misleading information will result in immediate disqualification.
{companyName} reserves the right to modify or cancel the drive without prior notice.
